explanation: Chemicals correspond to ingredients: chemicals in chemical reactions are the fundamental substances of the reaction, while ingredients in cooking are the fundamental substances of making delicious food. Both of these are basic materials in their respective fields.

Catalysts correspond to seasonings: catalysts in chemical reactions can accelerate the process of the reaction, while seasonings in cooking can enhance the taste of the food. Both of these substances play a role in improving and accelerating the process in their respective fields.

Products correspond to delicacies: the products in a chemical reaction are the newly created substances after the reaction, while delicacies in cooking are the delicious food made through cooking. Both of these are the final products in their respective fields.

background.source: Chemistry is a branch of natural sciences that deals with matter, its composition, properties, and changes that occur during a reaction with other substances. It is a broad subject area that covers everything from the elements that make up matter to the compounds made of atoms, molecules, and ions. In chemistry, the chemical bonds in chemical compounds are also an essential aspect addressed. Often referred to as the "central science," chemistry provides a foundation for understanding basic and applied scientific disciplines. It occupies an intermediate position between physics and biology, explaining various phenomena in botany, geology, ecology, cosmochemistry, pharmacology, and forensics. Chemicals are the building blocks of everything we know in this world, and a catalyst is a substance that facilitates a chemical reaction. A product is the result of a chemical reaction, often desired for its usefulness in society, such as the creation of new medicines or advanced materials.
background.target: Cooking is one of the most essential skills we practice every day, and it is both an art and a science. From grilling, baking and roasting to sautéing, boiling, and frying, cooking has various techniques to prepare food to satisfy our taste buds. Adding the right ingredients and seasoning to a dish makes it more flavorful, which is why it's a vital part of cooking. Cooking can be done for daily meals at home or for creating delicacies in high-end restaurants. It is fascinating to note that humans have been cooking for more than 2 million years ago. Archaeological evidence also indicates that humans have been using fire to cook for at least 300,000 years. With the expansion of agriculture, trade, and transportation, cooking techniques evolved, and it continues to do so. Adding to the traditional methods, modern cooks use advanced scientific techniques to enhance the flavors, texture and presentation of the dish. Cooking, therefore, is an essential life skill that everyone should learn, making mealtime more enjoyable for everyone.
